title: Grid-connected LFP battery storage system
description:
Project brief: grid-connected lithium iron phosphate battery energy storage plant at a site in Germany.

Requirements at the connection point: usable energy 3 MWh and rated power 1.5 MW, charging and discharging, 2 h duration, guaranteed for the full 15-year service life. Expected duty: 1 equivalent full cycles per day. Project margin policy at this design stage: 15% on energy and 10% on power, on top of the requirements. The plant will also be prequalified for frequency containment reserve (FCR) in Germany with 1.5 MW, symmetric.

Grid connection, from the network operator's connection letter: 10 kV; network short-circuit power at the connection point 350 MVA, R/X 0.3. The operator's technical connection rules for medium voltage apply in full.

Plant architecture: one string per rack; every string connects to its own DC input on a PCS unit (no combiner boxes; a PCS unit's inputs share one DC bus, and the PCS units are paralleled on the AC side into one step-up transformer, then the medium-voltage switchgear at the connection point). Cells in series in modules of 16 (the series count is a multiple of 16). Each string has one fuse and one contactor and runs to the PCS over one DC cable pair (optionally several pairs in parallel) of 60 m route length, with 6 strings sharing each cable tray. DC circuit time constant L/R 2 ms. DC cable voltage drop limit 3% (project specification). Auxiliaries (cooling and heating units, rack electronics, site systems) are supplied from the plant's medium-voltage busbar behind the connection point through an auxiliary transformer.

Site: maximum ambient 45 C, minimum ambient -15 C, annual mean 10 C, altitude 800 m; cable ambient inside the enclosure 35 C; enclosure heat loss 27.3 W/K per rack.

Cell datasheet (LFP prismatic): 3.2 V nominal, 280 Ah, 2.5-3.65 V, DC resistance 0.69 mOhm at beginning of life, continuous 0.5 C charge and discharge at 25 C, recommended SOC window 5-95%, open-circuit voltage 3.13 V at 5% SOC, maximum cell temperature 55 C, price 79.38 per cell.
